senses.definition: In a relative manner; with reference to environment or competition; contextually or comparatively.

quotes.text: In the present position of Europe, it is obvious, that France domineers. She has gained positively, by adding territory to her dominions [...]; she has gained relatively, by removing Austria to a distance, and by weakening that ancient rival to such a degree, as to secure her inaction for an age.
